news.title: Sources: Peralta arranged Soto-Lindor meeting
news.summary: Multiple sources told ESPN that former Mets pitcher Freddy Peralta in June arranged for franchise cornerstones Juan Soto and Francisco Lindor to vent and work through their disconnected relationship.

news.title: Source: Struggling DH Ozuna released by Pirates
news.summary: Veteran designated hitter Marcell Ozuna, who is hitting just .203 with eight home runs, has been released by the Pirates.

news.title: Guardians call up top prospect Genao, DFA Arias
news.summary: Infielder Angel Genao, who is Cleveland's top prospect per ESPN rankings, has been called up by the Guardians. He has a .309 average at Triple-A Columbus.

news.title: Yanks' Lombard homers in debut, joining brother
news.summary: George Lombard Jr. became the third-youngest Yankee to homer in his first game, and he did it on a night when his little brother also went deep in his own professional debut.

news.title: Arraez has 2 hits, 2 RBIs in 'beautiful' Phils debut
news.summary: Newly acquired Phillies second baseman Luis Arraez had two hits and drove in two runs in the Phillies' 5-0 win on Tuesday.

news.title: Dodgers' Rushing dealing with slight tear in elbow
news.summary: Dodgers catcher Dalton Rushing has a slight tear in the UCL in his right elbow, follow-up testing revealed.
